newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Fernandez to lead fin'l delegation to UK.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Fernandez to lead fin'l delegation to UK.

text.p: Argentine Economy Minister Roque Fernandez begins a week-long visit to Britain Monday aimed at promoting Buenos Aires as a regional financial center.
Fernandez will participate in a conference attended by Britain's Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke and visit the Bank of England and several private investment firms.
"It is important to present Buenos Aires as a center for financial services," the Under-Secretary for Banking and Insurance Francisco Susmel said of the visit.
"We think Buenos Aires should have an ample regional role based on our freedom for transactions, our deregulated framework, our financial market industry," he told reporters.
Fernandez will travel accompanied by Central Bank President Pedro Pou, National Securities Commission President Guillermo Harteneck and Buenos Aires Stock Exchange head Julio Macchi.
Private bankers and the heads of the insurance and pension funds chambers will also travel with the minister.
The tour will include a two-day visit to Edinburgh, where Scottish and Argentine officials will participate in a conference on banking and investment.
